$schema-note: Every cost-estimate assumption lives HERE, nowhere else — token PRICES stay in config/models.json `pricing`. Edit values freely; bump assumptionsVersion whenever you do so every displayed estimate is traceable to the assumption set that produced it. Validated by lib/utils/shared/costEstimator.ts at module load. The `typical` request profile is deliberately NOT here: it is config/emissions.json typicalRequest, imported, so the cost figure and the CO2 tooltip can never disagree about what a typical request is. Grounding for the defaults is documented in that file's JSDoc.
